info.name: Mist Admins Sites Marvis Configs API

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field to count by. enum: `mac`, `type`, `src`, `admin_id`, `op`, `port_id`, `reason`, `vlan_ids`

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter by device MAC address

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by config type (e.g. wired)

params.name: src
params.description: Filter by source of the config action (e.g. marvis)

params.name: admin_id
params.description: Filter by admin ID

params.name: op
params.description: Filter by operation type (e.g. disable_port, enable_port, update_mtu, add_vlans_to_port)

params.name: port_id
params.description: Filter by port identifier (e.g. ge-0/0/13)

params.name: vlan_ids
params.description: Filter by VLAN ID

params.name: reason
params.description: Filter by reason for the config action (e.g. rogue_dhcp_server_detected)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`
